_readme: Text of the in-app page at /guide/ (built by scripts/build-guide.mjs). Chinese is allowed here because this file is in docs/. Keep it minimal: a title, a few short lines and one download button.

en.title: Book pack kit
lines: Give this kit to an AI agent. It explains how to turn an EPUB into a book pack for this app.
A book pack is one .zip with exactly two files: book.epub and glossary.json. A plain EPUB cannot be added.
Inside: the format (Markdown), a sample book and word list, and a ready-to-add sample pack. Add it with Add book.

zh.title: 图书包工具包
lines: 把这个工具包交给 AI。它会说明怎样把一本 EPUB 做成这个应用能用的图书包。
图书包是一个 .zip 文件，里面正好有两个文件：book.epub 和 glossary.json。单独的 EPUB 不能添加。
里面有：格式说明（Markdown）、示例书和示例词表，还有一个可直接添加的示例图书包。在“添加图书”里选择它。
